notes: Synthetic ordinary-task prompts only; no production prompts or telemetry.
Expected answers are frozen before candidate tool descriptions are scored.
Tool names match agent-audience entries in the pinned agent-inventory fixture, plus sentinel none.

prompts.prompt: I have never worked in src/murlocs/impact.py. Before I edit anything, help me get oriented on the guidance that applies to that path.
prompts.notes: Composite orient is the task-shaped first call; explain is an acceptable granular alternative.

prompts.prompt: Starting a feature that will touch tests/test_impact.py. What repository guidance should I read first for that area?
prompts.notes: Unfamiliar work on a named path → orient.

prompts.prompt: This checkout might only be partially migrated to Murlocs. Before I change src/murlocs/cli.py, tell me where adoption stands and what is safe next.
prompts.notes: Adoption/orientation of an unfamiliar or partial migration often starts with status.

prompts.prompt: Why does src/murlocs/verify.py inherit the rules it does? Show me the guidance chain for that file.
Which AGENTS.md map owns tests/test_hooks.py, and what invariants apply there?
prompts.notes: Ownership/explanation of a path is explain.

prompts.prompt: Summarize the operating rules that apply when editing src/murlocs/task_commands.py.
I staged several guidance-related edits. Review the guidance impact of my staged change set before I continue.
prompts.notes: Explicit change-set review → review-changes; impact is the granular primitive.

prompts.prompt: Here are the paths I changed in the working tree: src/murlocs/outcome.py and docs/outcome-envelope.md. Which guidance scopes and checks should I review?
For commits HEAD~3..HEAD, report which Murlocs scopes and registered checks are affected.
prompts.notes: Revision-range change review stays on review-changes/impact.

prompts.prompt: Run guidance impact for the explicit paths src/murlocs/hooks.py and tests/test_hooks.py.
prompts.notes: Caller asks for the granular impact primitive by name.

prompts.prompt: My staged work is done. Get a fresh structural completion receipt for the staged change set without running registered repository checks.
prompts.notes: Task-shaped completion → finish; check is an acceptable granular structural gate.

prompts.prompt: I am ready to mark this task complete against the current working tree. Produce the completion-oriented Murlocs receipt.
Before I wrap up, validate that managed guidance, proofs, coverage, and ownership still check out on this repository.
prompts.notes: Caller asks for structural validation rather than the composite finish envelope.

prompts.prompt: There is an inert curation proposal under .murlocs/curation/ that claims a core operating rule is stale. Review the proposal and its prospective guidance model without promoting anything.
prompts.notes: Friction review stays on inert curation surfaces.

prompts.prompt: Validate the inert curation records in this repository before an owner looks at them.
The generated guidance for src/murlocs/paths.py feels contradictory. Help me understand the active chain before anyone drafts a curation change.
prompts.notes: Understand friction first; do not silently mutate active guidance.

prompts.prompt: This repository still has legacy .stewards maps. Inventory existing guidance and ownership conflicts before we import anything.
Compare the legacy guidance with its Murlocs candidate projection so we can see what would change.
Are we adopted, candidate-only, or still legacy here, and what is the next safe migration action?
Fix the spelling typo in the module docstring of src/murlocs/errors.py. Do not change behavior.
prompts.notes: Ordinary code edit; first action should not be a Murlocs tool.

prompts.prompt: Add a unit test that asserts sha256_bytes of b'abc' matches the known digest. Keep it local to the existing test helpers.
In a single function in src/murlocs/identity.py, rename a local variable for clarity without changing the public API.
In Python 3.14, what is the difference between list[str] and Sequence[str] for a function parameter?
prompts.notes: Language question with no repository guidance need.

prompts.prompt: Look at src/murlocs/agent_inventory.py and tell me what matters.
prompts.notes: Intentionally underspecified; orient, explain, or reading code without a Murlocs call can all be first moves.

prompts.prompt: I think I am done with my edits to the guidance sources.
prompts.notes: Could mean completion receipt, structural check, or change review depending on host habit.
